sections.label: Professional Summary
sections.text: Junior software developer with a B.S. in Game Programming and Development (summa cum laude, 4.0 GPA) and hands-on experience building backend systems, CLI tools, and database-driven applications in Python, Go, and C#. Comfortable working across PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and SQLite, with additional background in big data engineering (Spark, Hadoop, Hive) and AWS deployment. Demonstrates a pattern of solving problems outside framework boundaries — including cross-platform systems work, C# interop, and procedural systems design. Actively expanding skills through Boot.dev coursework in Go, SQL, and systems programming. Certified in Python (PCEP) and Neo4j.

items.subtitle: Summa Cum Laude; National Society of Collegiate Scholars; Alpha Sigma Lambda. GPA: 4.0.
details: Relevant Coursework: C++ in Unreal Engine, HLSL shader programming, 3D modeling and texturing (3DS Max, Photoshop), C# programming, Game design, Software engineering principles, Data structures and algorithms

Continuing Coursework: Python, Go, SQL, Linux/Unix, Git, OOP, Functional Programming, Data Structures, Algorithms, Big-O Analysis, HTTP Client Development, Relational Database Design, Memory Management in C

items.title: Package Handler
bullets: Process packages in a high-volume warehouse environment while maintaining accuracy, speed, and safety.
Demonstrate consistent reliability and performance in physically demanding, time-sensitive operations.

items.title: Preloader
bullets: Loaded and organized packages for time-sensitive delivery routes in a fast-paced morning operation.
Maintained efficiency and attention to detail while working under strict deadlines.

items.title: Senior Associate
bullets: Earned the Neo4j Certified Professional credential through independent self-directed study of graph data modeling and Cypher query writing.
Earned the PCEP certification from the Python Institute through dedicated self-study.
Supported a banking sector data consolidation project, managing Jira tickets and tracking issues as the team worked to migrate distributed data into a centralized master repository.

items.title: Software Associate
bullets: Completed 400 hours of big data engineering training covering Scala, Spark, Hadoop, HDFS, and Hive.
Built a Scala CLI application performing CRUD operations on JSON data to manage user and game state.

Contributed to a team Spark project analyzing a nationwide COVID dataset spanning millions of locations and a full year of daily records, calculating per-location case changes and growth factors across the entire United States.
Deployed Spark jobs to AWS cloud infrastructure.
Used Hive to analyze sample datasets and answer scenario-based business questions.

items.name: Gator
bullets: Built a CLI RSS feed aggregator backed by PostgreSQL with support for user registration and login, feed subscription management, and configurable automatic aggregation polling on a set interval.
Posts are stored and browsable with a configurable result limit; installable globally via go install.

items.name: KasaPlugControl
bullets: Built a cross-platform battery charge controller using TP-Link Kasa smart plugs that monitors battery level and automatically toggles charging to extend battery lifespan.

Shipped a persistent system tray icon, Pushover push notifications for critical alerts, a vigilance mode that triggers platform-specific hibernation on unexpected discharge, and an optional multi-cycle calibration mode.
Runs natively on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

items.name: Stadium Rental Suite
bullets: Architected a two-application tournament management system with a shared MongoDB backend, coordinating a C# desktop client and a host-facing web app with no direct communication channel between them.
C# client allows players to build and save their team and submit match inputs; web app receives submissions and manages bracket execution.
Includes a GitHub Pages landing page as a unified entry point.

items.name: Spinning Wheel
bullets: Built a streamer-focused tool in Godot; identified that the engine lacks native global hotkey support, a hard requirement for a tool used while another window has focus.
Integrated a C# global hotkey library and wrote the interop layer connecting hotkey events to the Godot application, working outside the engine's standard toolset to ship the required feature.

items.name: Paintball
bullets: Built a complete paintball game in Unreal Engine with all gameplay logic in C++, no Blueprint editor permitted.
Procedurally generated mesh geometry by manually computing vertices, normals, tangents, UV coordinates, and triangle indices for dynamic mesh actors.
Implemented a shader-driven countdown effect and a noise-based dissolve effect using dynamic material instances and USF pixel shader files.
Architected a full game state machine using a C++ enum exposed to Blueprints, a custom PlayerController class, a UMG HUD widget, and Blueprint-callable hit detection functions.

items.name: Hyperspace Shinies
bullets: Built a static web reference tool live on GitHub Pages, driven entirely by local JSON data with no backend or build step required.
Implemented expandable type-coded encounter tiles, live search with autocomplete, and filtering logic that accounts for multi-pool spawn interactions.

items.name: Fuzzy Farmer
bullets: Built a fully realized Unreal Engine game featuring original 3D models and textures created in 3DS Max and Photoshop, procedurally generated trees from Blender, composed background music, and custom foley audio.

items.name: Team Type Calculator
bullets: Built a desktop GUI application in Python with Tkinter to evaluate Pokémon team type coverage and identify weaknesses.

items.name: Password Generator
bullets: Built a CLI tool that generates cryptographically secure passwords with configurable length and character composition; in daily personal use.

items.name: pokedexcli
bullets: Built a Go CLI REPL that queries the PokéAPI over HTTP to retrieve and display game-area encounter data, with stateful session management across commands.

items.name: Static Site Generator
bullets: Built a Python tool that converts Markdown documents into a complete static HTML site; generated site deployed live on GitHub Pages.

items.name: AI Agent
bullets: Built a Python AI agent handling external API calls and structured response handling.

items.name: Asteroids
bullets: Built a recreation of the classic Asteroids arcade game in Python using Pygame.
